propositions: Pure single-pass prepacked verification produces false-positive rejections when the prepack is imperfect; a hybrid FILTER (PASS/ABSTAIN only, no FAIL) + narrowed agentic fallback eliminates false-positive rejections by construction.

A deterministic per-AC evidence pack builder (grepping for AC-named symbols, file slices, referencing commits, test functions) combined with a single zero-temperature LLM call achieves 39% real-ticket coverage with zero false-PASSes on adversarial unmet ACs.
Filter + narrowed fallback reduces token spend 26% overall (-46% on all-met tickets) with negligible filter cost, outperforming pure-agentic verification while maintaining correctness.
Filter coverage is bimodal by AC linguistic style: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) PASS reliably; ACs asserting runtime outcomes or store-side artifacts rationally ABSTAIN.
The existing ticket-load seam (show_ticket monkeypatch) enables AC-block reduction and automatic fallback step-budget narrowing without structural changes to verify_completion.
